items.title: fix: avoid duplicate attachment choices in iOS Safari (#152271)
items.summary: fix: avoid duplicate attachment choices in iOS Safari (#152271) Use one Attach… action for conservatively identified iOS Safari-style web browsers, independently of viewport size. Preserve the existing camera, photo and file paths on Android, desktop, alternative iOS browsers, unknown identities and declared native/embed hosts. Share the existing iOS platform hint without changing Web Push behavior. Verified with exact-head CI, 56 focused bundled-browser tests including both formerly failing CI scenarios, fresh independent review, and inspected before/after UI evidence. Native phone picker dialogs were not device-tested. Co-authored-by: vyctorbrzezowski Co-authored-by: hannesrudolph

items.title: perf(test): reuse PR and release tooling fixtures (#153710)
items.summary: perf(test): reuse PR and release tooling fixtures (#153710) Keep independent Git state and real wrapper and worker execution while sharing prepared fixture repositories. Advance the Android observation fixture clock and retain its real timeout and cleanup probes. On one isolated Linux Testbox with one Vitest worker, the five files pass the same 1,116 cases and reduce aggregate wall time from 647.51s to 580.89s.
